_comment: Per-tool requirements for labor-insurance-sim (simulated — not connected to the Bureau of Labor Insurance), held by the gateway because it decides before the server is reached. A tool mapped to null is public. A tools/call naming a tool not listed here is refused: the list is closed. `arguments` are rules on the call itself, checked with the credential: an enrolment or withdrawal may be filed for today or up to ten days ahead, 'today' being the date at VLEI_POLICY_UTC_OFFSET (+08:00 in deploy/agentgateway).
